name: nightgate-mermaid-toolchain
description: The pinned mermaid render toolchain for scripts/validate-diagrams.sh. Exact versions plus the committed package-lock.json pin the FULL transitive tree by integrity hash; the validator installs it with `npm ci --ignore-scripts`, so nothing here runs a lifecycle script - the browser comes from PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH or the script's explicit probe, never from puppeteer's postinstall download.
